### 1. Most Important Fact
MosChip Technologies has agreed to acquire a **73% stake in Vayavya Labs Private Limited (VLPL) for ₹266.71 crores** (₹154.52 crores in cash via internal accruals and ₹112.19 crores via the preferential issue of 50,50,686 equity shares at ₹222.14 per share). The remaining 27% will be acquired after March 31, 2028, with valuation linked to VLPL's performance. Concurrently, MosChip reported a swing into a consolidated net loss of ₹3,040.22 lakhs for Q2 (ended 30-Sep-2026) driven by cost escalations on a complex turnkey ASIC project.
